title: i18n: an object with an extension label keeps that label in every locale, so Studio shows "Account (Success Overlay)" in zh-CN while the bundle holds 客户
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ① a measured break. Filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29672 · i18n.studio-follows-app-locale · acceptance[2]
Reader: `domain:server` (the label localisation on the object read). Root cause not read.
Dedupe: `Success Overlay`, `extension label locale`. #8037 and #8284 (both closed) are nearby. **New.**
type: Bug

Measured on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_account?locale=zh-CN` answers `label: "Account (Success Overlay)"`. Runner readings, not re-derived: `pluralLabel` in the same read is 客户; `showcase_project` reads 项目; the bundle holds `objects.showcase_account.label` 客户; the app shell's sidebar reads 客户; Studio's rail and header read the English. The label comes from `examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts`.

Wanted: one rule for which wins when an extension sets a label and a bundle translates it, the same on every read. If the extension's label is meant to win in every locale, say so, and correct the showcase and the checklist clause instead.

Links back: #29672.
